 Advertisement San Juan River flooding leaves Shiprock homes underwater
 Advertisement Updated: 10:36 PM MDT Oct 24, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Vincent Rodriguez Digital Content Manager San Juan River flooding leaves Shiprock homes underwater
 Updated: 10:36 PM MDT Oct 24, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Vincent Rodriguez Digital Content Manager SHIPROCK, N.M. — Flooding from the San Juan River has left homes and neighborhoods in Shiprock underwater, prompting Navajo Nation President Buu Nygren to address the community during this challenging time. 
 "Our teams are out here really trying to respond and do everything that we can to mitigate and also at the same time to respond as well too," Nygren said. 
 Advertisement "We are going to be working on this. This is not the next couple of days; it's going to be the next several weeks that the Navajo Nation has to respond to the devastation we are feeling right now," he said. 
 Nygren posted a video on his social media pages showing the damage in the Shiprock area. The footage revealed playgrounds partially submerged in floodwaters and the San Juan River surging along a bridge. 
 Nygren added that he is working with fellow lawmakers on the Navajo Nation to draft legislation to allocate $10 million for disaster relief efforts.
